name: Anime Wonder Washington
blurb: The Ridgefield, Washington stop of the multi-city Anime Wonder festival, held at the Clark County Event Center.

editions.evidence: Official site's 'Coming soon' landing page, 2026 Schedule block: 'CLARK COUNTY EVENT CENTER Ridgefield, WA Dec 5-6, 2026 ** NEW DATE'.

notes: The official site is currently a 'Coming soon' placeholder (HTTP 503, 'WEBSITE RE-LAUNCH SOON'). Its own schedule block shows the Ridgefield, WA date moved to Dec 5-6, 2026 (marked '** NEW DATE'), which supersedes the Oct 17-18, 2026 date in the original seed note; third-party aggregators (fancons.com, animecons.com) still show that older Oct date and one marks it 'Postponed', but the con's own site is preferred per instructions. Anime Wonder is a multi-city brand also running a Waco, TX stop (Nov 21-22, 2026); this file covers only the Ridgefield, WA edition. No guest page or ticket link is live on the placeholder site, so guestsPage/tickets are left blank. Organizer name could not be confirmed from the official site; an aggregator attributes it to 'Fueled By X, LLC' but that was not independently verified, so it is omitted.
